title: Chapter 311 - 311 Choice; Shock!
content:
Chapter 311 - 311 Choice; Shock!

Chapter 311 - 311 Choice; Shock!

311 Choice; Shock!

Under the envious gazes of the students, Lin Fan and Ran Fei walked out together.

Soon, they arrived at Feng Weijian’s office.

Ran Fei had also come into contact with many young geniuses.

However, no matter how talented these young people were, they would still be somewhat restrained in front of him.

Ran Fei believed that there were two reasons for this.

Firstly, there was a difference in wealth.

Secondly, it was the difference in social status.

From the moment he saw Lin Fan in the classroom, Ran Fei had been observing him secretly.

Ran Fei realized that Lin Fan’s expression was extremely relaxed and calm.

He could not help but praise the genius who solved several math problems and invented the earthquake prediction device and super battery. He was indeed different.

In fact…

It was normal for Lin Fan to have such a reaction.

Speaking of wealth…

Lin Fan’s wealth far surpassed Ran Fei’s.

In terms of social status…

Lin Fan was the second largest shareholder of Penguin Group and Little Tanuki Group. He was also the largest shareholder of Imperial Hotel, Yinshan Group, Xiao Wu Wholesale City, and so on. He was also the captain of the Dragon Division.

In addition, Lin Fan was also on good terms with Qin Weiming, Zhou Guotao, and the other elders.

In terms of social status, Ran Fei did not hold a candle to him.

This was equivalent to a superior and a subordinate walking together. How could Lin Fan be nervous?

Ran Fei sat down and said, “Mr. Lin, you should know that our Dahua Phone Group is divided into two business segments. The first is communication equipment, and the second is smartphones.”

Lin Fan saw that Ran Fei was about to say something and interrupted, “Chairman Ran, you just said that you want to cooperate with me on my super battery.”

Ran Fei immediately understood that Lin Fan did not like to beat about the bush.

“I know about the super battery,” he said. “You must have spent a lot of effort to invent it. So, we don’t plan to buy the patent right away.”

No, Ran Fei was thinking too much.

Lin Fan only spent about an hour watching the battery experiment and reading a few battery-related books.

Ran Fei continued, “I’ve prepared two ways of cooperation for the time being. Mr. Lin, take a listen to it first. Of course, you can also state your requirements.

“The first option is for Dahua Phone Group to spend 500 million yuan and obtain the right to use the super battery for ten years. You can continue to sign corresponding cooperation agreements with other companies.

“The second option is for our Dahua Phone Group to spend 1.5 billion yuan to obtain the exclusive rights to the super battery for ten years. Other companies who want to use the super battery will need to sign a contract with our Da Hua Phone Group.”

Vice Chancellor Feng Weijian, who was sitting next to them and had been silent all this while, trembled slightly as he held the glass of water.

500 million!

1.5 billion!

Feng Weijian had seen a lot of the world.

However, he was still shocked by such a large number.

Lin Fan’s face was still calm as he said, “I’ll go for the second option.”

This was not because Lin Fan felt that 1.5 billion was a lot of money and that was why he chose it.

One had to know…

1.5 billion was only the price of a high-end office building.

Lin Fan had a few such office buildings.

In addition, Lin Fan had several billion yuan in his own account.

The real reason was that Lin Fan felt that it was too troublesome to sign contracts with different companies.

Gulp!

Feng Weijian, who was sitting at the side, could not help but swallow his saliva.

1.5 billion!

Ran Fei took a deep breath and said, “Alright, I’ll get someone to send the contract over now.”

Although the technical director had already done several experiments to prove that there was no problem with the thesis data, the 1.5 billion patent fee was still a huge gamble for Ran Fei!

It would be fine if no one could invent a better battery in the next few years.

If someone invented a better battery soon, it would definitely be a blow to Dahua Phone Group.

After a series of crisp sounds from the fax machine, three warm copies of the contract appeared in Ran Fei’s hands.

Ran Fei first spent about 20 minutes carefully checking the contract before handing a copy to Lin Fan. He said, “Mr. Lin, please take a look.”

Compared to Ran Fei’s meticulous manner, Lin Fan was much more casual.

Lin Fan quickly flipped through the contract. After a few seconds, he stopped and said, “Alright, there’s no problem with the contract. Shall we sign it directly?”

Ran Fei was slightly stunned.

No problem?

Was he not going to take a look?

He did it so casually?

This was a 1.5 billion contract!

Ran Fei did not know that Lin Fan had a scanning ability.

Although Lin Fan only spent a short time reading it, his understanding of the contents of the contract far exceeded Ran Fei’s.

Even if he wanted Lin Fan to recite the contents of the contract, it would not be a problem.

Seeing that Ran Fei did not reply, Lin Fan asked, “What else do we need to wait for?”

“No, no, no. There’s no need. You can sign it now,” Ran Fei replied.

Lin Fan nodded. He picked up the pen on the table and quickly signed his name.

Ran Fei also signed his name and stamped the official seal he carried with him.

Feng Zijian, who was sitting at the side, swallowed his saliva again.

A 1.5 billion sky-high contract was completed in front of him just like that?

He felt that it was so unreal.

“Mr. Lin, I’ve already asked the finance department to transfer the money to you. It should arrive soon,” Ran Fei said.

Lin Fan nodded his head casually and did not really mind.

Sure enough, after a while, the phone in his pocket vibrated.

[Notice from Merchant Bank: 1.5 billion yuan was deposited into your account.]

Lin Fan waved his phone and said, “It’s in my account.”

Ran Fei took the initiative to extend his hand and said, “Mr. Lin, it’s a pleasure to cooperate.”

At this moment, Lin Fan stretched out his hand and said, “To a happy cooperation.”

…

The news of Dahua Phone Group spending 1.5 billion yuan on the patent for the super battery quickly spread.

This time, it was not just the mobile electronics industry that was shaken. The entire internet was shaken as well.

On Weibo.

Love of a Lifetime: [1.5 billion? Heavens! Oh my god! How could a patent be so valuable?]

Fat Monkey King: [I finally understand why the elderly always said that education is important. From now on, I’ll study hard! When a beauty comes to chat with me, I’ll kick her away because I want to study hard! If the beauty invites me to drink milk tea, I’ll reject her directly because I want to study hard. If the beauty asks me to watch a movie with her, I’ll tear up the movie ticket because I want to study hard! Women will only affect my studies!]

You, Me, Him: [The commenter above… What are you thinking? Why would a beauty look for you?]
